claims: NASA's Artemis II mission is scheduled to launch on April 1, 2026, at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
NASA's Artemis II mission marks the first crewed flight to the Moon in over 50 years.
NASA's Artemis II mission has a duration of 10 days.
NASA's Artemis II mission features four astronauts.
NASA's Artemis II mission will conduct a lunar flyby to test systems before returning to Earth.
Launch site for NASA's Artemis II mission is NASA's Kennedy Space Center, Florida (Pad 39B).
Crew of NASA's Artemis II mission consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch (NASA), and Jeremy Hansen (CSA).
Mission goal of NASA's Artemis II mission is to verify life support systems with a crew on a deep space mission.
